name: acard
description: Scoped virtual cards for AI agents: pay at merchants and x402 APIs under limits and human approvals.

interface.shortDescription: Give your agent a card it can't run away with
interface.longDescription: A-CARD gives each agent task its own virtual card: a per-charge cap, a total budget, a merchant-category allow-list and a human-approval threshold. Codex can create cards, pay at merchants, pay per-call APIs over x402, search verified suppliers on A-MERCHANT, and read the wallet and transactions. Every decline comes back with the reason. Run `node ./server/acard-mcp.mjs setup --api-key ak_…` once to connect your A-CARD account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a single-use A-CARD card capped at R500 for this purchase, pay with it, and tell me the decline reason if A-CARD refuses.
